title: China-to-Moldova Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: TS EN 62109 Safety Evidence for PV Inverter Power Converters
rows.target_requirement: Moldova follows a CE- and EN-aligned route for many electricity products as an EU-candidate market. For PV inverter safety, TS EN 62109-1 and TS EN 62109-2 are commonly used as technical evidence, and ANRE or project approval documents determine whether these become mandatory for a specific model and site.
rows.china_equivalent: China inverter evidence typically uses GB/T 37408 and related grid code files with GB/T performance reporting. These do not directly certify EN/TS EN safety scope unless mapped with model-level technical analysis for the Moldovan route.
china_standards: Voluntary CQC / CGC / IEC reports where available
rows.gap: The gap is whether the safety file is structured as EN/TS EN 62109 evidence for the Moldovan model, including thermal limits, abnormal operation behavior, insulation and protection design, and clear versioned installation language for operation and commissioning in local conditions.

mandatory_status.target: Voluntary as a standard unless ANRE, Moldelectrica, project procurement, or contract makes it mandatory for the model and site
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — China GB/T inverter evidence is not itself EN/TS EN 62109 conformity proof

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not assume EN/TS EN 62109 compliance by equivalence only. Use a model-by-model dossier with translation, parameter maps, and project acceptance criteria for the Moldova target.

rows.target_requirement: Moldova solar projects should satisfy ANRE project conditions and Moldelectrica or local distribution-company interconnection expectations for project type, connection point, and market role. Product test reports are useful but not substitutes for project-level approval, protection settings, commissioning, and acceptance documentation.
target_standards: ANRE energy market and grid-connection regulations
rows.china_equivalent: China State Grid and GB/T 19964-2024 evidence can support technical planning, yet it does not replace Moldova interconnection documents or ANRE approval conditions for each project and site.
rows.gap: The Moldova gap is typically in project acceptance scope, including single-line diagrams, inverters model certificates, protection settings for 230/400 V 50 Hz operation, metering and remote-control interfaces, commissioning records, and operator communications in the correct site language set.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for projects that require ANRE interconnection and distribution connection approval
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory or project-specific in China utility practice, but not accepted as Moldova grid approval in itself

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat Moldova interconnection approval as a project-by-project process. China grid certificates can support technical review, but they do not satisfy Moldovan project acceptance by themselves.

rows.target_requirement: Moldova-connected PV inverters are commonly reviewed for anti-islanding and loss-of-mains behaviour during project acceptance by ANRE and site operator expectations. IEC 62116 and EN 50549-series references are commonly used, but setting values and documentation format remain project-specific in Moldova.
target_standards: Project-specific distribution and interconnection protection settings
rows.china_equivalent: China test reports under GB/T 37408 and GB/T 19964-2024 support technical review, yet trip thresholds and reconnection behavior must be mapped to Moldova project settings before commissioning.
rows.gap: The gap is parameter compatibility and evidence traceability for Moldova acceptance, including anti-islanding test reports, voltage and frequency trip tables for 50 Hz 230/400 V systems, reconnection logic, firmware control, and commissioning trace records.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where local grid acceptance requires anti-islanding and loss-of-mains protection as a commissioning criterion
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — Chinese settings are engineering references but need Moldova-specific confirmation

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat anti-islanding evidence as a project acceptance item for the Moldova site. China default trip settings and GB/T evidence need review before commissioning and handover.
